concerns.text: FR-029 (rigorous regression evaluation protocol) is not referenced in any phase of the plan. The plan mentions training and evaluating the regression model but does not specify the stratified 20 % train‑test split, 5‑fold cross‑validation, or the required reporting of R², MAE, and permutation‑baseline drop.

FR-032‑VERIF (re‑run G*Power after final sample size selection and record the result) is absent. The plan computes required N but does not state that the power analysis will be reproduced and logged after the actual N is chosen.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 5 – Interaction Significance, Sensitivity, Partial Correlation, Universality
concerns.text: FR-033 (manual validation subset of 500 stress curves for independent R² check) is missing. No task creates or uses a manually‑annotated validation set.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 5 – Interaction Significance, Sensitivity, Partial Correlation, Universality
concerns.text: SC-009 (precision ≥ 0.90 and recall ≥ 0.90 for collapse‑point identification against a 500‑curve ground‑truth set) is not addressed. The plan does not include a precision/recall evaluation step.

FR-026 (comprehensive logging of all metric computations for auditability) is only implied by the presence of `utils/logging.py` but the plan does not explicitly state that every metric (SSS, WER, R², etc.) will be logged as required.
